responsibility: This file provides the stock library of trivial hook implementations that GCC uses as default initializers for target, language, and host hook vectors. It contains many small functions with standardized signatures that simply return constant booleans, integers, null pointers, identity values, or do nothing, allowing hook tables to be fully initialized without every frontend or backend defining boilerplate handlers. It also includes a few generic policy helpers such as the default MI thunk capability predicate.
same_name_distinction: Provides the compiled definitions of generic default hook bodies—no-op, constant-returning, null-returning, and simple policy helpers like the MI thunk predicate—while gcc/hooks.h is only the prototype catalog used to reference those defaults from hook initializers.
